text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Generous free tier and excellent value for paid plans",
    "Streamlined creation of various item types (logins, notes, cards, SSH keys)",
    "Robust organization, filtering, and search capabilities",
    "Flexible item creation with optional fields",
    "Strong security features and open-source transparency",
    "Reliable cross-device syncing"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve for advanced features and organizational setup",
    "UI can be less intuitive, especially for custom fields and team management",
    "Separate Admin Console makes team management feel disconnected from the main vault",
    "Mobile app experience can be inconsistent or less smooth than desktop",
    "Limited reporting features for enterprise users",
    "Customer support response times can be slow"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.5
}

pros: Generous free tier and excellent value for paid plans
Streamlined creation of various item types (logins, notes, cards, SSH keys)
Robust organization, filtering, and search capabilities
Flexible item creation with optional fields
Strong security features and open-source transparency
cons: Steep learning curve for advanced features and organizational setup
UI can be less intuitive, especially for custom fields and team management
Separate Admin Console makes team management feel disconnected from the main vault
Mobile app experience can be inconsistent or less smooth than desktop
Limited reporting features for enterprise users
Customer support response times can be slow
